name: Factory License (Maharashtra)
authority: Directorate of Industrial Safety & Health (DISH Maharashtra)
description: Statutory occupational safety and factory licensing under Section 6 of Factories Act, 1948 and Maharashtra Factories Rules, 1963 for industrial premises employing 10 or more workers with power.

metadata.statutory_fee: Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 40,000 based on worker count and installed electrical horsepower
required_documents: Form 1 Application for factory plan approval
Sectional elevation and machinery layout drawings signed by chartered structural engineer
Structural stability certificate signed by authorized competent person
MIDC land possession letter or registered industrial lease deed
MSEDCL industrial power sanction letter and connected load certificate
NOC from Directorate of Maharashtra Fire Services
List of plant directors/partners with identity and address proofs
application_steps: Register on Maharashtra Kamgar portal (mahakamgar.gov.in)
Submit factory plan approval dossier in Form 1 with chartered structural engineer stability certificate
Upon plan approval, complete plant machinery installation and safety perimeter guards
Submit Form 2 Notice of Occupation at least 15 days before commencement of manufacturing shifts
Pay statutory licensing fee via GRAS payment gateway
Joint inspection by DISH Factory Inspector and download digitally signed Factory License

name: MPCB Consent to Establish (CTE)
description: Statutory environmental clearance under Section 25 of Water Act 1974 & Section 21 of Air Act 1981 prior to site construction, machinery installation, or effluent generation in Maharashtra.

metadata.statutory_fee: Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 based on gross capital investment
metadata.validity_period: 5 years or until commercial plant commissioning
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with industrial water balance diagram
Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) engineering blueprint and chemical process flow chart
Chartered Accountant Gross Capital Investment Certificate
MIDC allotment letter / land title deed
Air pollution control equipment (APCM) design for boiler and generator stacks
application_steps: Log in to MPCB e-CMP portal (ecmpcb.in)
Select industrial classification (Red Category for textile dyeing/wet processing)
Upload DPR, water balance diagram, and ETP engineering design
Pay consent fees based on gross capital investment
Regional Officer conducts siting inspection and MPCB Member Secretary grants CTE

name: MPCB Consent to Operate (CTO)
description: Mandatory operational environmental clearance under Section 25/26 of Water Act 1974 & Section 21 of Air Act 1981 required prior to commercial production shifts and trade effluent discharge.

metadata.statutory_fee: Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 75,000 annually based on gross capital investment
required_documents: Copy of previously granted Consent to Establish (CTE)
Commissioning certificate of Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) / CETP membership proof
NABL accredited treated effluent laboratory analysis report
Stack emission monitoring report from MPCB approved laboratory
Environmental audit statement (Form V)
application_steps: Apply for Consent to Operate in Form I on MPCB e-CMP portal 60 days prior to commissioning
Upload ETP commissioning certificate and CETP discharge agreement
Submit treated effluent and stack emission laboratory test results
MPCB Field Officer conducts compliance verification inspection
Receive digitally signed Consent to Operate order

name: MPCB Hazardous Waste Authorization
description: Statutory authorization under Rule 6 of Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management & Transboundary Movement) Rules 2016 for generation, storage, and disposal of chemical sludge, spent dyes, and contaminated containers.

metadata.statutory_fee: Rs. 7,500 to Rs. 20,000 co-terminus with Consent to Operate
required_documents: Form 1 Application for Hazardous Waste Authorization
Agreement with Common Hazardous Waste Treatment, Storage & Disposal Facility (CHWTSDF)
Layout drawing of hazardous waste storage shed with impervious flooring and leachate collection
Hazardous waste generation manifest and record register (Form 3)
application_steps: Execute agreement with authorized CHWTSDF operator (e.g. MEPL Ranjangaon/Taloja)
Submit Form 1 application for hazardous waste authorization concurrently with CTO on MPCB portal
Inspect storage shed and emergency spill kits
Obtain combined Consent to Operate and Hazardous Waste Authorization

name: Industrial Steam Boiler Registration & Certificate
authority: Directorate of Steam Boilers, Government of Maharashtra
description: Statutory registration, inspection, and fitness certification under Section 7 & 8 of The Indian Boilers Act, 1923 and Maharashtra Boiler Rules for industrial steam boilers used in textile dyeing, drying, and wet processing.

metadata.portal_name: Maharashtra Directorate of Steam Boilers Portal
metadata.statutory_fee: Rs. 3,500 to Rs. 15,000 depending on boiler heating surface area
required_documents: Manufacturer Form II, Form III, and Form IV inspection certificates
Steam pipeline layout drawing and design approval from Chief Inspector of Boilers
Welder qualification certificates from accredited testing agency
Non-destructive testing (NDT) and radiography test reports
Boiler Operation Engineer (BOE) / certified boiler attendant appointment letters
application_steps: Submit steam piping drawings and boiler specifications on mahaboiler.gov.in portal
Erect boiler and steam piping through certified boiler erector
Inspector of Boilers conducts hydraulic pressure test at 1.5 times working pressure
Issue of Registry Number and provisional order for commercial operation
Issue of Certificate in Form VI for 12 months

name: Textiles Committee Statutory Cess & Inspection
authority: Textiles Committee, Ministry of Textiles, Government of India
description: Mandatory registration, monthly statistical production returns, and cess remittance under Section 5A of Textiles Committee Act, 1963 for commercial spinning and weaving mills.

metadata.statutory_fee: 0.05% ad-valorem statutory cess on value of manufactured textiles
required_documents: Entity registration certificate / Udyam MSME certificate
Monthly production register of yarn spun and fabric woven
Monthly sales invoices and excise valuation records
Quarterly Textiles Committee Return in Form A
application_steps: Register mill with Regional Office of Textiles Committee (Ichalkaranji/Mumbai/Solapur)
Obtain mill registration code
Submit monthly production and dispatch returns online
Remit statutory cess through Bharatkosh electronic gateway

name: Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) Registration
authority: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: Mandatory statutory registration and monthly provident fund contribution under Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 for factories employing 20 or more workers.

metadata.portal_name: Shram Suvidha Unified Portal / EPFO Unified Portal
metadata.statutory_fee: Nil statutory filing fee; 12% employer + 12% employee statutory monthly contribution
required_documents: Entity PAN and Certificate of Incorporation / Partnership Deed
Factory License or Udyam Registration Certificate
Specimen signature of authorized signatory with digital signature certificate (DSC)
Employee wage register showing gross wages and bank details
application_steps: Apply for EPF establishment code on Shram Suvidha portal (shramsuvidha.gov.in)
Submit entity details and digital signature certificate (DSC)
Receive 15-digit alphanumeric EPF Establishment Code
Generate Universal Account Numbers (UAN) for all 180 factory workers
File monthly Electronic Challan cum Return (ECR) by the 15th of each month

name: Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Registration
authority: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: Mandatory medical insurance and social security registration under Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948 for factories employing 10 or more workers in implemented industrial areas.

metadata.statutory_fee: Nil statutory filing fee; 3.25% employer + 0.75% employee monthly contribution for wages <= Rs. 21,000
required_documents: Entity PAN, GSTIN, and Factory License
Proof of address of factory premises (electricity bill / lease deed)
List of all factory workers with date of appointment and monthly wages
Bank cancelled cheque of entity
application_steps: Apply for 17-digit ESIC Employer Code on Shram Suvidha portal
Register all eligible factory workers and issue e-Pehchan insurance cards
Deduct and remit monthly statutory contributions by the 15th of every month via SBI payment gateway

name: Central Ground Water Authority NOC for Ground Water Abstraction
authority: Central Ground Water Authority (CGWA), Ministry of Jal Shakti
description: Mandatory prior No Objection Certificate (NOC) for industrial abstraction of groundwater via borewells or tubewells for textile dyeing, wet processing, and boiler feed water.

metadata.portal_name: CGWA NOC Portal for Ground Water Abstraction
metadata.statutory_fee: Rs. 10,000 application fee plus ground water abstraction charges based on quantum (m3/day)
required_documents: Detailed hydrogeological report and industrial water balance flowchart
Piezometer borehole design and telemetry digital water flow meter specifications
Rainwater harvesting and artificial recharge proposal plan
Consent to Establish / Operate from Maharashtra Pollution Control Board
application_steps: Submit online application on CGWA portal (cgwa-noc.gov.in)
Upload hydrogeological report, water balance, and rainwater recharge plan
Install tamper-proof digital water flow meter with telemetry on all borewells
Pay ground water abstraction charges and receive CGWA NOC
